description: Automatic mining with an in-game settings window, ore filters, nearest/furthest targeting and saved per-character On/Off. Optional approach, survey and compression. Open with /AutoMining.

fields.label: Apply Launcher settings
fields.description: Apply changed settings at the next login. In-game changes stay saved until you change these Launcher settings again.

fields.label: Ore filter
fields.description: Separate ores with commas, for example veldspar,scordite. Leave empty to mine all compatible resources.

fields.label: Start with
fields.description: Choose the nearest or furthest compatible asteroid in reach.

fields.label: Approach out-of-range resources
fields.description: Fly toward matching resources in this scene when none are in reach.

fields.label: Lock targets automatically
fields.description: Turn off to use only targets you have locked yourself.

fields.label: Use Mining Surveyor automatically
fields.description: Activate the built-in Mining Surveyor while AutoMining is on.

fields.label: Survey interval (seconds)
fields.description: Seconds between automatic surveys. Default 60. The client permits at most ten detailed scans per minute; an ongoing scan is never interrupted.

fields.label: Compress resources automatically
fields.description: Compress resources aboard using an active compressor the pilot can access in range. Normal fleet and resource restrictions apply.
